title: GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 tier comparison for project orientation
hypothesis: At least one GPT-5.6 tier gives LCA a better quality, reliability, latency, and token-cost tradeoff than GPT-5.5 for a grounded project-orientation turn under the unchanged agent loop.
falsified_if: No GPT-5.6 tier is non-inferior to GPT-5.5 on deterministic pass rate and mean score while improving at least one of latency, token use, or estimated API cost without a material regression in the others.
efficiency_outcomes: prompt, cached, cache-write, and output tokens
estimated input, cached-input, and output cost at published prices
decision_rule: Do not replace GPT-5.5 or introduce routing from this scenario alone. A tier is an orientation candidate only if five runs are non-inferior on pass rate and mean score. Prefer the least expensive candidate inside a 10-point score band unless latency is materially worse. Any routing policy must then survive simple-prompt, auth-api, existing-codebase-edit, failure-recovery, and investigation comparisons.
